_comment: Reviewed, WRITTEN licence exceptions that apply to ONE built image only (scripts/license-gate-image.mjs --scope <image>).
Same rules as licenses/exceptions.json (ecosystem, name, version, condition, reason, reviewedBy, date; weak copyleft needs
'unmodified-not-linked'; AGPL / EUPL / source-available / unknown can never be excepted), plus: `scope` (the image), and
`review` (when the exception must be looked at again). Versions are EXACT on purpose: a version bump makes the entry unused, the
image gate fails on an unused entry, and the exception has to be re-reviewed and re-signed for the new version.
Kept apart from licenses/exceptions.json so the exception does not reach the repo-wide gate or any other image.
Scope "builder" (images/base/builder, the App Builder image) is read by scripts/check-builder-sbom.mjs, NOT by license-gate-image.mjs:
owner exception 2026-11-27 for MPL-2.0 ONLY, ONLY for the five unmodified upstream Go modules BuildKit and runc link (the module paths are
also hard-coded in that script, so widening the list needs a code change AND a data change), ONLY inside the upstream binaries
buildkitd/buildctl/runc/rootlesskit. Policy, rationale and obligations: THIRD-PARTY-LICENSES.md, "Narrow MPL-2.0 exception: the App Builder image".

exceptions.name: psycopg
exceptions.reason: LGPL-3.0-only. Required by LiteLLM's database migrations (litellm-proxy-extras imports it unguarded in both migration resolvers; without it db-migrate exits with ModuleNotFoundError). Shipped unmodified from PyPI, pure-Python implementation, imported dynamically at run time by the MIT litellm-proxy-extras code, on the system libpq5 (PostgreSQL licence); replaceable by the user with any psycopg build (the image is a plain venv). psycopg-binary is NOT shipped. Licence text: psycopg-3.3.6.dist-info/licenses/ in the image; attribution: licenses/notices/litellm-oss-image.md.
exceptions.reviewedBy: owner (Alexander Borek), written sign-off relayed by the coordinator on PR #346
exceptions.review: Re-review on every LiteLLM bump (the exact version pin forces it) and at the latest 2027-05-24; drop it when LiteLLM makes psycopg optional (draft upstream issue in docs/components/litellm-oss.md).

exceptions.reviewedBy: owner (Alexander Borek), written sign-off relayed by the coordinator on PR #346
exceptions.review: Re-review on every version change of the lock (exact pin) and at the latest 2027-05-24.
